sim.adapt.note.modal: Ixazulula, bese ihlaziya izakhi lapho izimo zemodi zingalungile khona kakhulu (isilinganiso sika-Zienkiewicz–Zhu sayo yonke imodi ecelwe, zonke zibalwa ngokulinganayo) bese ixazulula futhi, kuze isilinganiso sibe ngaphansi kwenjongo noma imidlalo iphele. Ezingxenyeni ezinobuso obuyisicaba kuphela, amafrikhwensi angehla kuphela kusuka kumdlalo kuya kwelandelayo; ubuso obugobile buyasondela futhi ekubunjweni kwabo kwangempela, okungashintsha kancane ngalolunye uhlangothi. Isilinganiso siyisilinganiso, asiyona imingcele.
sim.adapt.note.buckling: Ixazulula, bese ihlaziya izakhi lapho izimo zangaphambi kokucindezeleka nezimo zokugoba zingalungile khona kakhulu (Zienkiewicz–Zhu, zonke zibalwa ngokulinganayo) bese ixazulula futhi, kuze isilinganiso sibe ngaphansi kwenjongo noma imidlalo iphele. Bheka isici somthwalo sizinza kusuka kumdlalo kuya kwelandelayo. Isilinganiso siyisilinganiso, asiyona imingcele.
sim.adapt.modal.units: Isilinganiso sephutha ngo-% (zonke imodi ezicelwe), amafrikhwensi emvelo ngo-Hz.
sim.adapt.buckling.units: Isilinganiso sephutha ngo-% (ukucindezeleka kwangaphambili nezimodi), izici zomthwalo: imithwalo × lokhu kugoba.
sim.adapt.modal.chart: Iphutha elilinganisiwe nefrikhwensi yokuqala ngokusho kokungaziwa, iphoyinti elilodwa ngomdlalo ngamunye (ithebula elingenhla linezinombolo)
sim.adapt.buckling.chart: Iphutha elilinganisiwe nesici somthwalo sokuqala ngokusho kokungaziwa, iphoyinti elilodwa ngomdlalo ngamunye (ithebula elingenhla linezinombolo)
sim.adapt.modal.how: Umdlalo ngamunye uwukuxazulula okuphelele kumeshi ehlaziywe ngokwahlukanisa okuqinisekisiwe lapho isilinganiso sasikhulu khona.
sim.adapt.buckling.how: Umdlalo ngamunye uwukuxazulula okuphelele (ukucindezeleka kwangaphambili, bese kuba yizimodi zokugoba) kumeshi ehlaziywe ngokwahlukanisa okuqinisekisiwe lapho isilinganiso sasikhulu khona.

app.part.note_exact: I-kernel eqondile igcina amasekele ngempela, amasilinda namakhoni: amavolumu ne-STEP kuqondile. “Amajika” usetha ukuthi ukubuka, i-STL kanye ne-3MF kuhlukaniswe kanjani.

ui.stage.gl: Umbono we-3D wengxenye. Donsa ukuze uyiphendule, donsa ngesokudla ukuze uyishelelise, sebenzisa isikrolo ukuze usondeze; chofoza ubuso, umphetho noma ipulani ukuze uyikhethe.

ui.hint.1: Khetha ipulani (chofoza lapha noma kumlando), bese {sketch}.
ui.hint.2: Dweba: umugqa ({line}), unxande ({rect}), indilinga ({circle}). Engeza izilinganiso ({dim}) nobudlelwano esigabeni sesokudla.
ui.hint.4: Noma wehlise ifayela {file} noma ifayela le-STEP lapha. Livulwa kulo kompyutha; akukho okulayishwayo.
ui.stage.drop: Wehlisa ingxenye ye-PartCraft noma ifayela le-STEP ukuzeulivule
ui.status.kernel.title: Yiliphi ikernel eyakha ingxenye
ui.hint.3: {exit} isikethi, bese {extrude} noma {revolve} sona. Shintsha noma yiliphi inani kamuva: ingxenye iyakhiwa kabusha.
ui.settings.orbit.hint: Inkinobho yesobunxele: donsa ukuze uphendule ingxenye, donsa ngesokudla noma ngaphakathi ukuze ushelelise. Inkinobho ephakathi: inkinobho ephakathi (isikrolo esicindezelwe) iyiphendulisa, Shift + inkinobho ephakathi noma donsa ngesokudla ushelelise, futhi inkinobho yesobunxele ikhetha kuphela, ukuze ukuchofoza kungaphenduli ingxenye ngephutha.
ui.settings.scroll.hint: Ithrakpadi: swayiphela ngeminwe emibili ukuze uphendule ingxenye, bamba Shift uswayiphele ukuze ushelelise, cindezela ukuze usondeze; esikethini iminwe emibili ishelelisa. Isikrolo sempukane: isikrolo sisondeza ngaphansi kwesikhombi. 'Hlola ngokuzenzakalela' ithatha ukuskrola okuya ngecala noma okunembile njengethrakpadi.
ui.settings.autorel.hint: Kuvulekile: ukuchofoza okubambela kuphoyinti noma kuvelo kwenza kube ndawonye, futhi imigqa esondele ukuba ngaphezulu noma ibe mpandla iba ngentandokazi noma ibe nqunu. Kuvaliwe: isikhombi sisabambelela, kodwa akukho okuxhunyiwe kuze wengeze ubudlelwano wena, ngakho ukudonsa kungahlukanisa izinhlangothi.
ui.settings.corner.hint: Ikhyubhu lombono lihlala ngaphezulu kwesokudla kombono we-3D: chofoza ubuso, umphetho noma ikhoni ukuze ubuke kusuka lapho, donsa ukuze uphendule ingxenye. Isithonjana sezingatha yisimaki esincane se-X, Y, Z ngaphansi kwesobunxele. Azikho lapho udweba noma ku-ishidi lokudweba.

gen.dl.part: Ifayela lengxenye elinomphumela njengesixazululo esiphakiwe (esinezinhlangothi) selandiwe.
gen.added: Umphumela wengezwe engxenyeni njengesixazululo esiphakiwe (esinezinhlangothi) esihlanganiswe nayo.
gen.intro: Khulisa izimo ngezinhloso: khetha izinhlangothi ezibanjiwe nezithwala umthwalo, izifunda ozigcinayo nezigcinwa zicwebile, ivolumu enqunjiwe kanye nezinto. Umphumela ngamunye umumo oqinile kakhulu otholakele ngevolumu yawo (ukulungiswa kwetopholoji), uhlolwa futhi njengesixazululo esiqinile, futhi uboniswa njengendawo ebushelelezi onganilanda.
gen.ws.label: Ukuklama
gen.rmin.note: irediyasi yokuhlunga {r} mm: izingxenye ezincane kunalokhu ngamaphindwe amabili azikhiqizi
gen.method: Indlela: ukulungiswa kwetopholoji ukuze kuqiniswe (SIMP, isijeziso 3, isihlungi sobuningi, ukuhlunga ngomkhawulo, imibandela yokulungisa) kumesh yamakhyubhu, ukuma okulinganayo, into eyodwa ngesikhathi. Izinhlangothi ozilayisha noma ozibambayo ziyagcinwa zisoliwe; izinhlangothi ezingenakho ukungqubuzana azigcinwa (zivame ukuba ngamapuleni okulinganisa). Umphumela ngamunye ugcina ivolumu yawo enjongiwe, uhlolwa futhi njengesixazululo esiqinile nge-material yangempela, futhi ubushelelezi ube yindawo evaliwe ehlanganisiwe. Asikho imikhawulo yokucindezela noma imithetho yokukhiqiza (okuphakame, izinqondo zokusika) okwamanje: hlola umphumela ekulingiseni ngaphambi kokuwethemba.
gen.stale: Ingxenye ishintshile kusukela lapho lezi zakhiwa: khiqiza futhi.
gen.btn.add_off: Umphumela ungaphakathi kule ngxenye (indawo yokuklama ingxenye): wulande njengefayela lengxenye elisha esikhundleni salokho.
gen.outcome_note: Ukucindezela nokunyakaza komphumela njengamakhyubhu aqinile, okubi kakhulu phakathi kwemithwalo; indawo engaphezulu ibushelelezile kusukela kulawo makhyubhu. Ifayela lengxenye liwubamba njengesixazululo esiphakiwe esinezinhlangothi eziningi ezilinganayo, hhayi isimo esihlelekayo.
gen.ws.blurb: izimo ezikhulelwe ngezinhloso (izifunda zokugcina nokuvimba, imithwalo, inhloso yobunzima) njengabaqhudelani abaqhathaniswayo.

study.ws.intro: Ukucindezeleka okuzinzile okulinganayo nezinkombandlela zemvelo zalolu hlobo lwengxenye: khetha impahla, bopha ubuso, engeza amandla, izingcindezi noma isisindo sayo, bese uxazulula. Ingxenye ihlukaniswa ngamakhyubhu amancane (ama-hexahedron anamanodi ayi-8); imiphumela ibonakala ngemibala emodelini.

study.ws.tet_note: Imeshi: ama-tetrahedron anamanodi ayi-10 alinganiswe ezindaweni eziqondile zobuso (ukuthuthukiswa kwe-isosurface ku-lattice ehlukaniswe ngamazinga, kulungiswa eduze kobuso obugobile, izindonga ezincane nemiphetho ebukhali; amanodi asemngceleni nasemaphakathini asezindaweni eziqondile zamapuleni, amasilinda, amakhoni, amasfere, ama-torus, ubuso olugoqiwe nolusontekile nobuso be-B-spline; amanye ubuso ulandela imeshi yokubonisa), uxazululwe ngama-conjugate gradients nomlungisi we-algebraic multigrid. Ukuqina kwe-linear elastic, ukuguquka okuncane, impahla eyisotropic (amapulasitiki asuka ku-3D-printing abuthakathaka ngaphansi kwezendlalelo). Ukucindezeleka kuyalinganiswa emanodini; ezindaweni ezibukhali zangaphakathi nasemaphethelweni obuso obuvinjiwe kuyashintsha futhi kukhula njengoba imeshi icijwa: zifunde ngokuthile kude nazo.
study.ws.voxel_note: Indlela: ukuqina kwe-linear elastic, ukuguquka okuncane, impahla eyisotropic (amapulasitiki asuka ku-3D-printing abuthakathaka ngaphansi kwezendlalelo). Ingxenye igcwaliswa ngamakhyubhu alinganayo (ama-hexahedron anamanodi ayi-8, amamodi angahambisani njengokuzenzakalelayo) ukuze ubuso obugobile buphenduke izinyathelo; ukucindezeleka ezindaweni ezibukhali zangaphakathi nasemaphethelweni obuso obuvinjiwe kukhula njengoba amakhyubhu ehla (ayashintsha) — zifunde kude nazo. Kuxazululwa nge-conjugate gradients nomlungisi we-multigrid.

study.adapt.note_thermal: Kuxazululwa, bese kulungiswa izakhi ezinephutha elilinganisiwe elikhulu kakhulu bese kuxazululwa futhi, kuze iphutha elilinganisiwe libe ngaphansi kwenhloso noma ukudlula kuphele. Isilinganiso (Zienkiewicz–Zhu) kuyisilinganiso, hhayi umkhawulo, futhi sihlanganisa yonke ingxenye (energy norm): ukugeleza kokushisa okukhulu kudinga ngokuvamile inhloso engaphansi kuka-1 %. study.flow.turb_warning: Okokuhlola: le modeli yokuqubuka ayidlulanga ezivivinyweni zayo zokunemba. Amaphutha alinganisiwe: amachibi amathe, ukungqubuzana +3 kuya +5 % (Dean, iseli lokuqala ku-y⁺ 49–98); ichibi lodonga elichazwe ngokugcwele, isivinini esiphelele -1 % (Moser et al., y⁺ ≈ 3); ukungqubuzana kwepayipi 30 kuya 34 % kuphezulu; ukuxhumana kabusha ngemva kwesinyathelo esibuyela emuva 21 kuya 39 % kufushane; imiphumela iya ngokuthuthuka kancane kuphela uma amaseli ecijile. Sebenzisa lokhu ukuze uthole amaphethini okugeleza ngokwesimo (lapho ukugeleza kuhlukana khona, kuphindeke kuhambe noma kusheshe), hhayi izinombolo zokwakha.

study.flow.ui.ext.head: Ukugeleza ozungeze ingxenye
study.flow.ui.ext.note: Uhlangothi lwebhokisi okungena ngalo ukugeleza kungukungena ngalesi sivinini; uhlangothi oluphuma ngalo kungukuphuma ngo-0 Pa; izinhlangothi ezisecaleni ziyadlidliza (akukho ukungqubuzana). Ukudonsa kungamandla ahambisana nokugeleza, ukuphakama kuhambisana nomugqa ({lift}); izilinganiso zisebenzisa indawo yesikhombo (uma kungenalutho: indawo engaphambili yengxenye, ebonwa ngokugeleza). Ibhokisi elincane kakhulu lisheshisa ukugeleza ngaphansi kwengxenye futhi likhulise ukudonsa.
study.flow.ui.hook.choose: Khetha umngenisi noma umphumisi bese ucindezela Khetha ubuso ukuze wengeze ubuso kuwo.
study.flow.ui.hook.no_cmd: Ukuhlaziywa kokugeleza kusebenzisa abangenisi nabaphumisi: bengeze epanelini.
study.flow.ui.method_laminar: Indlela: ukugeleza okulayishile, okungacindezeleki, okushisa okulinganayo koketshezi oluyiNewtonian, kuxazululwa indlela ye-lattice Boltzmann (D3Q19, ukuhlangana kwesikhathi esiphindwe kabili) emaseleni alinganayo ekhyubhu, kuze kube isimo esizinzile. Izindonga azinakho ukunyakaza (no-slip): i-interpolated bounce-back ilandela izindonga ezigobile; i-bounce-back yenza kube yisinyathelo; abangenisi bamisa isivinini esilinganayo, abaphumisi ingcindezi ezimile. Ukugeleza nengcindezi kuyizinga lesilinganiso; ukuminyana nokunamathela koketshezi kuzinzile (akukho ukushisa, akukho cavitation, akukho mandla adonsela phansi). Ukuvulwa okuncane kunamaseli ambalwa kakhulu kwaziwa kancane. Ukwakhiwa kwelabhorethri: hlola imiphumela ebalulekile ngenye indlela.
study.flow.ui.method_turb: Indlela (okokuhlola): ukugeleza okuqubukayo, okungacindezeleki, okushisa okulinganayo koketshezi oluyiNewtonian njengesixazululo esizinzile se-RANS — ukugeleza okulinganiswe ngesikhathi, hhayi ukuhlukahluka kwakho. Imodeli ye-Spalart–Allmaras (izinhlayiya ze-finite volume emaseleni afanayo) inikeza ukunamathela kokuqubuka okusetshenziswa yindlela ye-lattice Boltzmann (D3Q19, ukuhlangana kwesikhathi esiphindwe kabili) iseli ngeseli. Amaseli angaseduze nezindonga asebenzisa umthetho kaSpalding wodonga esikhundleni sokuchaza ungqimba olumsulwa lapho, eligcinwa njengejubane lokudlidliza ezixhumanisweni zodonga. Imodeli iqubuka ngokugcwele yonke indawo (akukho izingxenye ezilayishile, akukho ushintsho), ihlanganise izingqimba zomkhawulo ezilinganayo ezindongeni, futhi inokunamathela okufanayo kokuqubuka. Isinciphisi se-Smagorinsky esincane sisebenza kuphela lapho igridi ibona ukuguquka okungemboziwe yimodeli (izingosi ezibukhali zomngenisi, ukuqala kokusebenza). Abangenisi bathwala ukuqubuka okungu-5 % (ukugeleza kwangaphandle: 1 %). Ayidlulanga ezivivinyweni zayo zokunemba: bona isexwayiso sangaphezulu nesihloko sosizo.
study.flow.ui.need_exact: Ukulingisa kokugeleza kudinga i-kernel enembile (isalayishwa, noma ayitholakali lapha).
study.flow.ui.open.none: Azikho izimbobo okwamanje: engeza umngenisi nomphumisi, bese uchofoza ubuso babo.
study.flow.ui.open.note: Abangenisi nabaphumisi bavala indawo yoketshezi. Khetha ubuso obuthe ngqo obuzungeza isimbobo (umphetho wepayipi, ubuso besixhumi): izimbobo zalobo buso zivalwa yisivalo lapho, ngakho yonke imbobo kulobo buso ingeyesimbobo. Noma yenza ikepisi elincane phezu kwesimbobo, njengakwamanye amathuluzi e-CAD, bese ukhetha ubuso bayo bangaphakathi. Isimbobo ngasinye sidinga elilodwa; udonga olumncane kunosayizi weseli lungavuza.

Uhhafu wosayizi weseli udla cishe izikhathi ezingu-16 isikhathi eside.
study.flow.ui.w.coarse: Amaseli amakhulu kakhulu kulokhu kugeleza (τ ye-lattice {tau}, inombolo yeseli yeReynolds {re}): imiphumela ayinembile kangako; amaseli amancane ayasiza.
study.flow.ui.w.lam_ext_shed_bad: Inombolo yeReynolds {re}: ngaphezu kwe-50 cishe, umlandela wento ephakade uyaphephezela izinyonga (okungazinzi). Kungenzeka ukuthi asikho isixazululo esilayishile esizinzile; lokhu kusebenza akuzinzanga.
study.flow.ui.w.lam_ext_shed_ok: Inombolo yeReynolds {re}: ngaphezu kwe-50 cishe, umlandela wento ephakade uyaphephezela izinyonga (okungazinzi). Kungenzeka ukuthi asikho isixazululo esilayishile esizinzile; lokhu kuzinzile, kodwa hlola kahle.
study.flow.ui.w.lam_ext_turb: Inombolo yeReynolds {re}: imingcele yesendlalelo iqala ukuba yiqubuka lapha. Imodeli elayishile ayikwazi ukuyibonisa lokho; ukudonsa nokuphakama akubambi. Zama imodeli yokugeleza equbukayo.
study.flow.ui.w.lam_pipe_trans: Inombolo yeReynolds {re}: iphakathi (2,000–4,000 emipayipini). Ukugeleza kwangempela kungaba yiqubuka; phatha umphumela ongelayishile ngesineke.
study.flow.ui.w.lam_pipe_turb: Inombolo yeReynolds {re}: ukugeleza kwepayipi kulo Reynolds kuyaqubuka. Imodeli elayishile ayichazi ukugeleza kwangempela (ukwehla kwengcindezi kuncishiswa): sebenzisa imodeli yokugeleza equbukayo.
study.flow.ui.w.mach: Ukugeleza okusheshayo kufinyelela i-lattice Mach {mach}: amaphutha okucindezeka kwendlela akhula ngaphezu kwe-0.3 cishe. Amaseli amancane noma umkhawulo ophansi wezinyathelo uyasiza ngesivinini.
study.flow.ui.w.sa_ext_laminar: Inombolo yeReynolds {re}: ukugeleza ozungeze ingxenye kuyelayishile lapha. Imodeli equbukayo iyithatha njengequbukile ngokuphelele; sebenzisa imodeli elayishile.
study.flow.ui.w.sa_ext_trans: Inombolo yeReynolds {re}: engxenyeni yangempela izendlalelo zomkhawulo ziqala zilayishile futhi ziqubuke kwenye indawo ngaphezulu kwayo (cishe ku-5 × 10⁵ ebusweni obuthe ngqo obubushelelezi). Le modeli ayinaso ukushintsha: iyithatha njengequbukile kusukela ngaphambili, okwandisa ukudonsa okungqubuzanayo futhi ifake imiphumela njengokuphuma kwesimo sedrag crisis emizimbeni eyindilinga.
study.flow.ui.w.sa_pipe_laminar: Inombolo yeReynolds {re}: ukugeleza kwepayipi kulo Reynolds kuyelayishile. Imodeli equbukayo iyithatha njengequbukile ngokuphelele futhi ikhulisa ngokweqile ukungqubuzana nokwehla kwengcindezi; sebenzisa imodeli elayishile.
study.flow.ui.w.sa_pipe_trans: Inombolo yeReynolds {re}: iphakathi (2,300–4,000 emipayipini). Imodeli equbukayo ithatha ukugeleza okuqubuke ngokuphelele; ukungqubuzana kwangempela kuphakathi kwamanani alayishile nequbukayo.
study.flow.ui.w.sa_unsteady: Ukusebenza akuzinzanga. Ngemuva kwento ephakade ukugeleza kwangempela kuphephezela izinyonga; ukusebenza kwe-RANS ezinzile khona-ke akunasixazululo esizinzile, futhi lezi zinombolo yisikhathi esisodwa sokugeleza okunyakazayo.
study.flow.ui.w.yplus_buffer: Iningi lamaseli okuqala lihlala ongqimbeni lokubuffer (y⁺ ephakathi {med}, phakathi kwe-viscous sublayer nelog layer), lapho le ndlela yodonga yayingaqinisekile kakhulu ezivivinyweni (ukungqubuzana kuze kube cishe 20 % kuphezulu). Amaseli amakhulu (y⁺ 30–300) noma amancane kakhulu (y⁺ ≤ 3) ayangcono.

study.thermal.note.worst: Engeza izinga lokushisa elisethiwe, ukuhamba komoya nokufanayo ngezansi. Amazinga okushisa axazululwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kusuka ezingeni lokuqala kwimeshi efanayo; bese kwenziwa ukuxazulula okuzinzile kokucindezeleka ezikhathini zokuxazulula ezisakazwe ngokulinganayo phakathi kokusebenza (kubandakanya nokuqala), ukuze kutholakale umlando wokucindezeleka, ukuphakama kwawo nokuthi kwenzeka nini. Amazinga okushisa asebenza kusukela ekuqaleni (ushintsho olusheshayo): ukucindezeleka ekuqaleni kuncike kusayizi wento.
study.thermal.note.time: Engeza izinga lokushisa elisethiwe, ukuhamba komoya nokufanayo ngezansi. Amazinga okushisa axazululwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kusuka ezingeni lokuqala kwimeshi efanayo, kuze kufike isinyathelo sesikhathi esiseduze nesikhathi esikhethiwe; bese ingxenye iyanwebeka nge α·(T − izinga lokushisa elingenakucindezeleka) ngalesosikhathi.
study.thermal.method.steady: Indlela: ukudluliselwa kokushisa, kulinganiswe (ukuhamba okungaguquki, ukuminyana namandla okushisa aqondile), kuzinzile, kuleyo mesh yekhyubhu efanayo (ama-hexahedra anama-node ayi-8), axazululwe ngama-conjugate gradients nesilungisi se-incomplete Cholesky. Ukugeleza nokuhamba komoya kusebenza ngesifunda sangempela sezinhlangothi. Imisebe iya ezungezile kuphela (akukho ukushintshana okuqondile phakathi kwezinhlangothi) futhi iyalinganiswa, h = εσ(T² + T∞²)(T + T∞), ixazululwe futhi kuze kuzinze. Izinga lokuhamba komoya ngokufaka okuyisisekelo (akukho ukugeleza koketshezi lapha). Akukho ukumelana nokuxhumana. Ukulinganisela kokushisa (okungenayo nokuphumayo) kuhlola ukuxazululwa ngakunye. Ukwakhiwa kwelabhorethri: hlola izingxenye ezibalulekile ngenye indlela.
study.thermal.method.transient: Indlela: ukudluliselwa kokushisa, kulinganiswe (ukuhamba okungaguquki, ukuminyana namandla okushisa aqondile), kushintshashintsha ngezinyathelo zesikhathi ngokusebenzisa {scheme} kusukela ezingeni lokushisa lokuqala elifanayo, kuleyo mesh yekhyubhu efanayo (ama-hexahedra anama-node ayi-8), axazululwe ngama-conjugate gradients nesilungisi se-incomplete Cholesky. Ukugeleza nokuhamba komoya kusebenza ngesifunda sangempela sezinhlangothi. Imisebe iya ezungezile kuphela (akukho ukushintshana okuqondile phakathi kwezinhlangothi) futhi iyalinganiswa, h = εσ(T² + T∞²)(T + T∞), ixazululwe futhi kuze kuzinze. Izinga lokuhamba komoya ngokufaka okuyisisekelo (akukho ukugeleza koketshezi lapha). Akukho ukumelana nokuxhumana. Ukulinganisela kokushisa (okungenayo nokuphumayo) kuhlola ukuxazululwa ngakunye. Ukwakhiwa kwelabhorethri: hlola izingxenye ezibalulekile ngenye indlela.
study.thermal.method.buckling: Indlela: ukugoba kwe-linear (eigenvalue). Ukucindezela okuqinile ngaphansi kwemithwalo kunikeza ukucindezeleka kuqala; bese (K + λKσ)φ = 0 ixazululwa ngezinombolo zomthwalo ezincane kakhulu λ ngokuphindaphinda kwesikhala-sikhala (K: ukuqina kwale mesh yekhyubhu, Kσ: ukuqina kwejometri yokucindezeleka kuqala). Ukugoba okulinganiselwe kukhombisa ngokweqile imithwalo yangempela yokugoba: izingxenye zangempela zinezinhlobo, ukucindezeleka okusele nokuguquka, nezinqwaba ezincanyana zingagoba ngaphansi kwalelo nani. Sebenzisa umphetho. Isilinganiso somthwalo esingaphansi kwe-1 kusho ukuthi igoba ngaphansi komthwalo osetshenzisiwe. Ukwakhiwa kwelabhorethri: hlola izingxenye ezibalulekile ngenye indlela.
study.thermal.note.static: Umthwalo wokushisa: impahla iyanwebeka nge α·ΔT (kulinganiswe, α ingaguquki); ukucindezeleka kungu σ = D(ε − α ΔT). Imithwalo yokushisa ilinganisa yona, ngakho-ke izimpendulo zisalinganisa imithwalo yemishini kuphela.
study.thermal.note.static_transient: Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi: quasi-static (akukho inertia), ukuxazulula okulodwa okulinganiselwe kokucindezeleka ngesikhathi ngasinye sokucindezeleka ngamazinga okushisa ashintshayo (k, ρ, cp, E, ν, α azinzile).

study.thermal.note.buckling: Ukugoba okulinganiselwe kukhombisa umthwalo ngokweqile lapho ingxenye yangempela igoba khona (okungaphelele, ukucindezeleka okusele, ukuguquka): sebenzisa umphetho omkhulu. Isilinganiso somthwalo yimpindaphindo yemithwalo esetshenzisiwe lapho ingxenye eqondile igoba khona. Izimo zilinganiswa zibe ngu 1 ekunyakazeni kwazo okukhulu kakhulu; usayizi nesimo sazo akusho lutho.
study.thermal.note.balance: Ukushisa okungenayo nokuphumayo kufingqwa phezu kwazo zonke izimo (izinga lokushisa elisethiwe libala okufanele liyinikeze noma limunce). Ukungalingani kubonisa ukuthi ukuxazulula kuvaleke kangakanani; okukhulu kusho ukuthi umphumela awuthembekile.

laser.aid: Thumela imidwebo kulaser: khetha ukuthi ungqimba ngalunye wenzani, bona ukuhamba kwekhanda, londoloza i-G-code yemodi yelaser ye-GRBL, noma uyithumele kusiphequluli. Hlola zonke izilungiselelo okuchithekayo kuqala, gqoka izibonakude zokuvikela ezilingana nelaser yakho, futhi ungalishiyi lilodwa ilaser elisebenzayo.
laser.start-values: Izinombolo ungqimba aqala ngazo ziwumbiko nje, hhayi izincomo zanoma yisiphi isinto: hlola kokuchithekayo bese ubhala lokho okusebenzayo. Izisika nezishayi zenziwa kuqala ngaphakathi, ngemva kokugcwalisa nezithombe.
laser.preview-label: Ukuhamba kwekhanda: imigqa eshisayo iboniswa ngombala, ukuhamba okusheshayo ngegreyi, ibhokisi eliluhlaza yilokho okushisayo
laser.nothing: Akukho okuthunyelwayo okwamanje: setha ungqimba oyedwa okungenani ukuze usike, ushaye, uqophe noma ugcwalise.
laser.est-note: Isikhathi siyisilinganiso ngaphandle kokusheshisa; umshini wangempela uthatha isikhathi eside kakhulu.
laser.warn-open-fill: Ungqimba {layer}: isimo esivulekile asikwazi ukugcwaliswa futhi asifakiwe.
laser.warn-shape-skipped: Ungqimba {layer} usethelwe isithombe: izimo zawo azifakiwe.
laser.warn-picture-skipped: Ungqimba {layer} awusethelwe ukuqopha isithombe: isithombe sawo asifakiwe.
laser.warn-out-of-bed: Umsebenzi ungu-{w} × {h} mm futhi awulingani nebhedi oyifakile.
laser.saved: I-G-code ilondoloziwe (imigqa {n}). Setha i-zero yomsebenzi ekhoneni elingezansi kwesobunxele lomsebenzi (noma ekuqaleni komdwebo, njengoba kukhethiwe) ngaphambi kokuyisebenzisa.
laser.send-note: Ukuthumela kusebenzisa i-Web Serial futhi kusebenza nezilawuli ze-GRBL ku-Chrome ne-Edge. Akukho okuxhumayo noma okuthunyelwayo kuze ucindezele inkinobho lapha, futhi Thumela ihlala ivaliwe kuze ikhanda selilandele ibhokisi lomsebenzi ngelaser livaliwe.
laser.no-serial: Lesi siphequluli asikwazi ukuxhumana nelaser nge-USB (akukho i-Web Serial). Londoloza i-G-code bese uyithumela ngohlelo lwelaser yakho.
laser.framed: Ikhanda lilandele ibhokisi lomsebenzi. Hlola ukuthi ihlezi phezu kwempahla yakho.
laser.confirm-frame: Ikhanda lizohamba lizungeze ibhokisi lomsebenzi ngelaser livaliwe. Ingabe indawo icacile ngaphandle kwanoma yini engashaywa?
laser.confirm-send: Ilaser izoqala. Ingabe impahla isendaweni futhi inohlaka, isivalo sivaliwe, izibonakude zokuvikela zigqokiwe, futhi kukhona umuntu oqapha umshini?
laser.stopped: Iyimile: ikhanda libanjiwe nelaser liphinde lisethwe futhi livaliwe.
laser.err-unsupported: Lesi siphequluli asikwazi ukusebenzisa i-Web Serial.
laser.machine-note: I-G-code ye-GRBL 1.1 kumodi yelaser: ukuhamba kwe-G0 ne-G1, M4 (noma M3) namanani e-S, M5 ekupheleni. Amafomethi ezinye izilawuli awakakhiwa.

illustrate.import.step: Amafayela e-STEP akavulwa ku-Kusuka kwenye ifayela ku-Illustrate okwamanje. Vula i-STEP ku-Design kunalokho (Vula, noma uyilahle esibukweni se-3D: ingena njengomzimba oqinile, akudingeki i-kernel eqondile), bese uqala umhlahlandlela Kusuka engxenyeni evulekile; noma uyilondoloze kuhlelo lwakho le-CAD njenge-glTF (.glb), 3MF, OBJ noma STL.

cam.post.editor.reference_how: Isiganeko ngasinye sidwala izinto eziguqukayo esingazisebenzisa, zibhalwe {{name}} emugqeni. Ezinye izinto zefomethi zisesihlokweni sosizo esithi Post processors.
cam.post.editor.verify: Hlola okuphumayo kumshini wakho ngesimulathi yawo ngaphambi kokusika. Iposi oliliguqulayo liyakho ukuliqinisekisa.
cam.post.editor.file_big: Leli fayela likhulu kakhulu ukuba liposi (izinhlamvu ezingu-60 000 ngokuphezulu).

variants.note.drawing: I-DWG iwukubukeka kwangaphambili, ngaphezulu, ngakwesokudla nenkombandlela ye-isometric yengxenye njengeshidi lomdwebo ngosayizi ogcwele; imigqa yayo ivela ku-mesh, ngakho ijika liyimigqa eminingi emifushane.

variants.readme.title: {part}: amavarianti {n}, akhiqizwe {date} yi-PartCraft
variants.readme.table: ithebhula lamapharamitha: amanani kavarianti ngamunye, izici azivala, amafayela awo
variants.readme.per: okunye ngakunye kwevarianti ngayinye, kuqanjwe ngokucushwa
variants.readme.item: ingxenye njengento eyodwa yomtapo kanye namavarianti ayo: yilayisha ku /library/upload
variants.ui.open_title: Akha ukucushwa ngakunye, noma isethi ekhethiwe, njenge-STEP, IFC, DWG nokubuka kuqala, nethebhula lamapharamitha awo, ngefayela le-zip elilodwa
variants.ui.title: Iphekhi yamavarianti
variants.ui.intro: Ukucushwa ngakunye kwakhiwa njengengxenye yayo. I-zip ibamba ifayela elilodwa lolunye uhlobo oluzikhethele ngakunye kokucushwa, ithebhula lamapharamitha awo (CSV ne-JSON), nengxenye njengento eyodwa yomtapo namavarianti ayo.
variants.ui.note: Ukwakha kwenziwa ukucushwa ngokulandelana, kusetshenziswa i-kernel esetshenziswayo; ingxenye yakho ayishintshwa.

sheets.intro: Vula i-DXF yamashidi ahlanganisiwe okhishwa i-add-on ye-Cabinets (noma yiliphi ukuhlanganiswa olunamapheshana SHEET ne-PARTS). Ishidi ngalinye liba uhlelo olulodwa: izimbobo nezikhala zokusika kuqala, bese kuba umbandela wengxenye ngayinye, ithuluzi ligcinwa ngaphandle kwengxenye kanye nokungena okuncane. Hlola izindlela zokusika ngokulingisa ngaphambi kokusika: lutho lapha lusebenziswe emshinini.

eng.notice.title: Izilawuli zokuthumela phandle
eng.notice.text: I-Engineer nabakhiqizi bayo yizinsiza zokuklama zenjongo ejwayelekile ezakhiwe ngobunjiniyela bezincwadi ezishicilelwe. Asinakho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi noma yimuphi umkhiqizi, umklamo, ishidi ledatha noma ifayela elithunyelwe phandle alinazo izinkinga zezilawuli zokuthumela phandle noma izimvume, noma ukuthi lingathunyelwa phandle, lithunyelwe kabusha, lidluliselwe noma lisetshenziswe kunoma yiliphi izwe noma yimuphi umuntu ngokomthetho. Wena uyabazwa ngokuhlukanisa lokho okuklama nokulandela imithetho yokuthumela phandle nezimvume ekusebenzayo kuwe. Lesi yisaziso esisisekelo: sicabanga ukushintsha lezi zilawuli ukuze zihambisane nemithetho yokuthumela phandle yezwe lapho umkhiqizi wapho kuvela khona.
eng.notice.short: Isaziso sokulawula ukuthumela phandle: bheka usizo lwe-QuantScope
study.nl.whole_steps: Inani lezinyathelo zomthwalo kufanele libe yinombolo ephelele.
study.nl.note: Impahla ilandela umugqa wayo oqondile kuze kufike ekuqiniseni okungu-{y} MPa, bese kuba nokuthambeka kuka-{Et} MPa (kuyashiywa = 1 % ka-E). Umthwalo uqhubeka ngezinyathelo; isinyathelo esingazinzi siyahlukaniswa ngamabili.
study.nl.note_contact: Izingxenye ezithintanayo ziyaphushelana (ngaphandle kokuxhumana) noma zibambekile (zixhunyiwe) ngezibhangqwana ezingaphansi; impahla iyaguquka njengocwaningo olungalingani (ukuthambeka ngemva kokuqina {Et} MPa, ukuqina {y} MPa). Ukuxhumana kuwukuhlola: izingxenye zicwila kancane ngaphakathi kwenye, nemiphumela iyatshela ukuthi kangakanani.
study.nl.picking_b: Chofoza izinhlangothi ze-B: izinhlangothi u-A azicindezela kuzo. Esc uma uqedile.
study.nl.pair_note: Khetha izinhlangothi ze-A ngo-"Khetha izinhlangothi", bese ze-B. Isijeziso yi-factor × E ÷ usayizi wenhlangothi: iphakamise lapho izingxenye zicwila kakhulu.

breakit.title: Phula kona
breakit.note: Ithola lokho okuzoqala ukuvuneka: inkomba yomthwalo wokuqala wokuvuna nokugoba, nokuthi ukucindezela kuphakama kuphi. Yonke imithwalo yocwaningo ikhula ndawonye.
breakit.running: Kuthathwa isinqumo sokuthi yini eqala ukuphuka…
breakit.row.yield: Ukuvuna kokuqala: {f}× womthwalo, ukucindezela okuphezulu {vm} MPa kumelana nomkhawulo: {yield} MPa, endaweni ({at}) mm.
breakit.row.yield.fail: Kuvuna njengoba kulayishiwe: kuthatha {f}× womthwalo kuphela (ukucindezela okuphezulu {vm} MPa kumelana nomkhawulo: {yield} MPa), endaweni ({at}) mm.
breakit.row.buckling.fail: Igoba njengoba kulayishiwe: inkomba yokugoba {f}, ingaphansi kwe-1.
breakit.stale: Ingxenye ishintshile kusukela lolu cwaningo. Yenza futhi.
breakit.method: Ucwaningo olulinganiyo: ukucindezela kukhula ngokulingana nomthwalo, ngakho inkomba yokuvuna iyisilinganiso sokuphepha socwaningo. Ukugoba kusebenzisa izisekelo nemithwalo efanayo. Ukucindezela endaweni eqinile kuphakama emaphethelweni alo.
breakit.p.yield.fail: {subject} iyavuna njengoba ilayishiwe: ithatha {factor}× womthwalo kuphela.
pc.lesson.first.title: Ingxenye yakho yokuqala
pc.lesson.first.intro: Kusukela engxenyeni engenalutho kuya kusolidi enembobo, ngezinyathelo ezintathu. Isinyathelo ngasinye sihlolwa engxenyeni ngokwayo, noma ngabe yenziwa kanjani.
pc.lesson.first.sketch.h1: Isikethi siqala isikethi endizeni: khetha indiza ephezulu.
pc.lesson.first.sketch.h2: Unxande noma isiyingi kuyisimo esivaliwe. Qeda isikethi lapho sesidwetshiwe.
pc.lesson.first.solid.h1: I-Extrude ihudula isikethi sibe yisolidi: khetha isikethi nojuqu.
pc.lesson.first.hole.h1: Isiyingi esidwetshwe ebusweni besolidi, sihudulwe njengokusikwa, senza imbobo; kanjalo nesici se-Hole.

nurbs.ui.title: Izinkalo
nurbs.ui.intro: Amajika e-NURBS nezinkalo ezingagcinwe nokuqhubeka okulinganisiwe (G0, G1, G2). Usayizi ngamamilimitha.
nurbs.ui.need.points: Bhala okungenani amaphoyinti angu-{n}, eyodwa ngomugqa ngamunye (x, y, z ngamamilimitha), noma uwakhethe embonweni.
nurbs.ui.need.edge: Khetha umphetho wenkalo ({have} kwezi {n}): chofoza eduze komphetho embonweni, noma inkinobho yomphetho ohlwini.
nurbs.ui.need.end: Khetha isiphetho sejika ({have} kwezi {n}): chofoza eduze kwesiphetho embonweni, noma Qala / Phela ohlwini.
nurbs.ui.ready: Kulungele: hlola izinketho bese ucindezela Yenza.
nurbs.ui.points.label: Amaphoyinti (x, y, z ngamamilimitha, eyodwa ngomugqa ngamunye)
nurbs.ui.points.hint: Chofoza amaphoyinti ejika ({n} kuze kube manje). Enter noma ukuchofoza kabili kuqeda, Esc ikhansela.
nurbs.ui.pick.hint: Chofoza ijika noma inkalo embonweni (eduze komphetho noma isiphetho uma umyalo ukucela lokho). Esc iyama.

pexp.scale.intro: Ifayela elilondoloziwe linesikali; ingxenye ngokwayo ayishintshi. Ukuvumela ukucwebezela kwenza iphethini ibe mkhulu ngamaphesenti okuzocwebezela ingxenye eyephonswayo.

pexp.scale.bad_factor: Inkomba imele ibe ngaphezu kwe-0.01 futhi ibe ngaphansi kwe-100.

pexp.split.intro: Ingxenye isikwa ibe izingcezu ezilingana nebhedi, ezixhunywe ngezixhumi, ngayinye inombolo. Ingxenye ngokwayo ayishintshi: izingcezu zilondolozwa njenge-zip nephepha lokuhlanganisa.
pexp.split.bad_bed: Uhlangothi lwebhedi kumele libe phakathi kwe-20 ne-2000 mm.
ui.tb.fmore.sketch_photo.title: Landela isithombe sengxenye eyisicaba (noma umdwebo wepeni) sibe isikethi samamugqa, amavini nezindilinga ngesikali onikeza
photo.ui.title: Isikethi esivela esithombeni
photo.ui.intro: Isithombe sengxenye eyisicaba ngesisekelo esisobala (kubandakanya nezimbobo), noma umdwebo wepeni, sishintshe sibe isikethi samamugqa, amavini nezindilinga. Nikeza ubude obubodwa ukuze isikethi sibe nosayizi ofanele. Silandelwa kulolu khompyutha.
photo.ui.no_scale: Akukho bude obunikeziwe: isikethi sizoba ngamapikseli.
photo.ui.limits: Imikhawulo yamakhona ibuyela phakathi kwe-5 %; imininingwane emincane kunepikseli noma amabili iyalahleka; isithombe esithathwe ngokuthambekile noma nezithunzi phezu kwengxenye akuqondiswa.
photo.ui.made: Kwenziwe isikethi samamugqa, amavini nezindilinga {n}, {w} × {h} mm.

surf.tb.float.title: Ntanta ubuso njengesikhumba somkhumbi: amaphaci avala kuwo aba yisolidi evaliwe, bese kubalwa ukuhlala kwamanzi, indawo yokuhlala, imetasentha nama-arm okubuyisela
hull.float.title: Ntanta ubuso
hull.float.intro: Ubuso {n} buhlanganiswa bube yisikhumba esivaliwe (imiphetho ehlangana iyahlanganiswa; ukuvulwa okuthambile njengedeki kuyavalwa). Bese isikhumba siyantanta siqondile, iphoyinti laso elisezansi lisesijuqu osinikeza. Akukho okubalwa kuze kuvalwe isikhumba.
hull.float.none: Akukho busho bokuntanta: dweba noma ulwelule ubuso besikhumba kuqala.
hull.float.mirror.z: uhlangothi olulodwa: buwonise phesheya komgogodla (phesheya = z)
hull.float.draft: Ukujula (ikili kuya emugqeni wamanzi; phezulu = y)
hull.float.kg: KG, isisindo esiphakathi sibe phezu kwekili (ngokuzikhethela: sinikeza GM nama-arm okubuyisela)
hull.float.open: Ubuso abuvali sikhumba: imiphetho {edges} inobuso obubodwa kuphela kanti {bad} yabelwana ngaphezu kwababili. Hlola ukuthi bonke ubuso {n} bahlangana ngomphetho ngomphetho, noma uthi bumisa uhlangothi olulodwa ukuze lubuyiselwe. Akukho okuntantiwe.
hull.float.solid: Isikhumba esivaliwe: izinxantathu {tri}, {capped} ukuvulwa okuthambile okuvaliwe.
hull.title: Lungisa imigqa
hull.intro: Ivini ngalinye lilinganiswa ngesimo salo sangempela: ukuguqula (lapho ligoba khona kuya ngaphansi ngendlela ehlukile), ukugoba okukhulu kakhulu, ukuguquka okukhulu kwe-curvature ku-node nokungalingani (ukuthi i-curvature iguquka kangakanani kulo). Amavini anokuguquka noma ukuguquka kwe-jump ayakhiwa kabusha ngamaphoyinti okulawula ancane kakhulu ahlala ngaphakathi kokubekezelela futhi angeqi ukuguqula. Ivini elishintsha ngempela isiqondiso (i-S) ligcina ukuguqula kwalo okukodwa.
hull.bad_tol: Ukubekezelela kuwubude mm, okumele kube ngaphezu kwe-0.
hull.no_curves: Akukho mavini okulungisa: dweba izimo, imigqa yamanzi noma izinsika kuqala.
hull.faired_one: {name}: amaphoyinti okulawula {cvs} (kwakunguyena {was}), {dev} mm kusuka emugqeni wakuqala, ukuguquka {inf} ngaphambili.
hull.nothing: Akukashintshwanga lutho: akukho vini elingenziwa lingcono ngaphakathi kokubekezelela.
hull.p.inflection: {name} ishintsha isiqondiso sokugoba izikhathi {n}: umugqa okahle womkhumbi ngokuvamile awuyenzi lokho. Lungisa, noma ugcine uma ukwakheka kuhloswe ukuba kube njalo.
hull.p.jump: {name} inokuguquka kwe-curvature {dk} 1/mm endaweni yenodi: umugqa awubushelelezi lapho (i-G1 kuphela).

nodes.hint: Xhuma ama-node: donsa kusukela endaweni ephumayo eyindilinga uye endaweni engenayo eyindilinga. Yonke i-node futhi ingumugqa wesikripthi.

study.mag.err.too_many: Izikethi zinamaphrofayili avaliwe {n}; ucwaningo luthatha kuphela {max}.

study.mag.err.no_source: Akukho okushayela inkambu: nikeza iphrofayili eyodwa umagineti (Br ngaphezu kwe-0) noma ikhoyili (ukugeleza kogesi).
study.mag.err.contour: Iphrofayili {n}: akukho ndawo yokuthatha amandla ezungeze kuyo ngaphandle kokuthinta enye imzimba noma umphetho wemodeli. Yenza umbandela webhokisi ubanzi kakhulu noma ushiye igebe.
study.mag.err.curve_line: Ivini B–H: “{line}” akuyona incazelo yezinombolo ezimbili.
study.mag.err.curve_rise: Ivini B–H kufanele liqale ngaphezu kwe-zero futhi zombili i-B ne-H zikhuphuka kumugqa ngamunye.
study.mag.p.saturation: Inkambu ifinyelela {B} T ensimbini enikezwe ukuvumela kuphela. Insimbi yangempela igcwala cishe ku-2 T, ngakho ukuphoqa nokugeleza kuphezulu kakhulu lapha: nikeza insimbi ivini B–H.
study.mag.ui.title: Ucwaningo lomagineti wesikethi
study.mag.ui.intro: Dweba imizimba yedivayisi yomagineti njengezimo ezivaliwe ezikethini (ijoka lensimbi, umagineti, ikhoyili). Iphrofayili ngayinye evaliwe iyindawo yemodeli eyisicaba; chaza ukuthi yini, uqhube, bese ubona inkambu, amandla nokuphenduka. Ungumklamo oyisicaba: konke kulinganiswa ngomitha ngamunye wokujula.
study.mag.ui.no_sketch: Lengxenye alinasikethi: dweba imizimba ezikethini kuqala.
study.mag.ui.touching: Imizimba ethintanayo yabelana ngomphetho: yibeke ezikethini ezihlukene. Imizimba emi ngokwehlukana noma ehlala ngaphakathi kwenye ingabelana ngesikethi esisodwa. Sebenzisa izikethi endizeni efanayo.
study.mag.ui.choose: Setha ingxenye yephrofayili ngayinye emodelini, bese uqhuba.
study.mag.ui.curve_note: Ipheya eyodwa ngomugqa, i-B ngu-tesla bese i-H ngu-A/m, zombili zikhuphuka. Ngevini insimbi iyagcwala; ngaphandle kwalo, inokuvumela okungenhla kuwo wonke amandla enkambu.
study.mag.ui.done: Isifundo sezinsimbi sesiqediwe: insimu ifinyelela: {B} T.
study.mag.ui.plot_alt: Ukuminyana kohlamvu lomagnethi kuyo yonke imodeli, okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka okumnyama kuphansi kuya kokubomvu kuphezulu, neziphambaniso ezinezinombolo
study.mag.ui.bmax: Insimu enamandla kakhulu: {B} T, x: {x} mm, y: {y} mm.
study.mag.ui.body: Iphrofayili {n}: amandla {fx} N ngokuhambisana no-x, {fy} N ngokuhambisana no-y (kanye {f} N); ukuphenduka {tau} N·m mayelana nephakathi layo.
study.mag.ui.depth_note: Ngobujulile: {d} mm. Ibhokisi lomoyaliyindonga: insimu ilungile kangangomoya osilungiselele imodeli, ngakho qhathanisa amabhokisi amabili anobukhulu obahlukile.
study.mag.ui.limits: Imodeli eyisicaba, ezinzile, ngaphandle kwemisinga ye-eddy nohysteresis; umagnethi ngumugqa oqondile wokubuyela emuva (akukho ukukhishwa kwomagnethi). Amandla asuka ku-Maxwell stress azungeze umzimba ancike kumeshi: yisebenzise Ejwayelekile neKuhle uqhathanise. Isisekelo sokudweba, hhayi ukuvunyelwa.
ui.tb.fmore.sketch_magnet.title: Bala insimu yomagnethi, amandla nokuphenduka kwamaphrofayili amaskethi avaliwe angensimbi, omagnethi nezinkoyili (imodeli eyisicaba, ngemitha ngayinye yobujulile)
study.mag.p.force_thin: Amandla asebenza kuphrofayili {n} athathwa endaweni yegebe elincane, phakathi kwamanxantathu amathathu wensimbi. Lowo msebenzi awulungile kahle: yisebenzise Ejwayelekile neKuhle futhi wethembe amandla kuphela uma evumelana.

nurbs.err.bool_empty: Umphumela awunalutho: izinqinile ezimbili azinalutho olufanayo (noma eyokuqala ingaphakathi kwesesibili). Akukho okushintshiwe.
nurbs.err.bool_trim: Ubuso bomphumela ({name}) abukwazanga ukusikwa ngokuhle emugqeni wokuhlangana. Akukho okushintshiwe.
nurbs.err.bool_detail: Ukuhlangana kudinga ngaphezu kwamaphoyinti {max} ebusweni obubodwa. Zama ukubekezela okukhulu.
nurbs.ui.need.solid: Khetha isiqinile ({have}/{n}): chofoza ubuso bayo kumbono, noma Khetha ohlwini Lwezinqinile.
nurbs.ui.need.more_surface: Khetha izindawo ezivala isiqinile ({have} okhethiwe), noma cindezela Yenza ukuze usebenzise zonke izindawo ezibonisiwe ezingakasikho esiqinile.
nurbs.ui.solid.none: Azikho izinqinile okwamanje. Yenza ibhokisi, isilinda noma ibhola, noma uqoqe izindawo ezivala ivolumu.
nurbs.ui.solid.made: {what}: kwenziwe. Ivolumu {volume} mm³, indawo {area} mm² (ilinganiswe ezinxantathwini, ukubekezela: {tol} mm kusukela ezindaweni).
nurbs.ui.solid.bool_done: {what}: kwenziwe, izinhlangothi {faces}, ivolumu {volume} mm³. Amaphoyinti enjini ahamba kuya ku-{dev} mm ukuze ahlale ezindaweni ezinembile (ukubekezela: {tol} mm); amaphoyinti okuhlangana ahlala phakathi kokubekezela: {res} mm kuzo zombili izindawo.
nurbs.ui.solid.open_again: Hlola: sekuhlanganiswe futhi kusuka ezindaweni ezinembile, imiphetho {n} isavulekile. Hlehlisa, noma zama ukubekezela okuncane.
nurbs.ui.solid.baked_mc: {name}isemodelini njengeqembu elivaliwe: izinxantathu {n} ngaphakathi kokubekezela 0.05 mm kuzindawo zayo, ivolumu {volume} mm³. Isiqinile esinembile sihlala lapha.
nurbs.ui.solid.bake_intro: Isiqinile siba yingxenye yengxenye, njengoba iSTL evulekile yenza: izinhlangothi zaso zibe izinxantathu ngaphakathi kokubekezela, zengezwe engxenyeni, zisikwe kuyo noma zihlanganiswe nayo. Kuyisinyathelo esisodwa sokuhlehlisa kwengxenye; isiqinile esinembile sihlala kuzindawo.
nurbs.ui.solid.bake_bad_tol: Ukubekezela kufanele kube ngu-0.001 kuya ku-10 mm.
nurbs.ui.solid.bake_big: Lokho kubekezela kunika izinxantathu ezingu-{n}, zinengi kakhulu komzimba owodwa. Zama ukubekezela okukhulu.
nurbs.ui.solid.bake_none: Akukho siqinile sokubhaka okwamanje: yenza esinye eqenjini Lezinqinile lepaneli.
nurbs.ui.solid.bake_failed: Ingxenye ayakhiwanga ngesiqinile esibhakiwe: {why}. Hlehlisa kukususa lokho.
nurbs.ui.solid.baked_pc: {name} ibhakwe engxenyeni ({op}): izinxantathu {n}, ivolumu {volume} mm³. Isiqinile esinembile sihlala kuzindawo.
nurbs.ui.tb.bake.title: Bhaka isiqinile se-NURBS engxenyeni (engeza, sika noma hlanganisa)
nurbs.ui.scan.none: Khetha kuqala imeshi: skena okufanele kulinganiswe kuyo izindawo.
nurbs.ui.scan.done: Kulinganiswe izinhlangothi {n} kuzinxantathu {tris} ({covered} % wendawo). Kulinganiswe kusukela ekuskeneni kuya ezinhlangothini: rms {rms} mm, okukhulu kakhulu {max} mm, {within} % wamaphoyinti ngaphakathi kokubekezela {tol} mm.
nurbs.ui.scan.title: Ukulinganisa kokuskena
nurbs.ui.scan.u.folded: Izinxantathu {tris} zigoqeka zibuyele kuzo, ngakho ubuso bubodwa abukwazi ukuzilandela
nurbs.ui.scan.note: Iphutha lilinganiswa kusukela kumaphoyinti okuskena kuya ephoyintini eliseduze kakhulu lobuso ngabunye, hhayi ngokuphambene. {ign} % wendawo ibincane kakhulu ukuze ilinganiswe futhi ayimbozwanga. Hlola izinhlangothi ngaphambi kokuzethemba.
nurbs.err.scan_none: Akukho kokuskena okulinganiswayo: khetha imeshi kuqala.
nurbs.err.scan_big: Lokho kuskena kunezinxantathu ezedlula: {max}. Nciphisa kuqala.
nurbs.ui.scan.fillets: Imiphetho egobile {n} (fillets) itholakele, ngayinye neradiyasi yayo.
nurbs.ui.scan.devlegend: Imibala ikhombisa ukuthi iphoyinti ngalinye lokuskena likude kangakanani nobuso balo: okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kubuso, okuluhlaza kuhhafu, okubomvu lapho kufika ekubekezeleni: {tol} mm noma ngaphezulu. Kulinganiswa kusukela ekuskeneni kuya ebusweni kuphela.
nurbs.err.fillet_face: {id} akuyona inhlangothi yesolidi {solid}. Khetha izinhlangothi ezimbili zesolidi eyodwa.
nurbs.err.fillet_edge: Izinhlangothi {a} kanye {b} azihlanganisi ngomphetho, ngakho akukho mphetho okufanele igoqwe.
nurbs.err.fillet_edges: Izinhlangothi {a} kanye {b} zihlangana ngemiphetho {n} ehlukene. Ukugoqa imiphetho eminingi ngesikhathi esisodwa akusakhiwa.
nurbs.err.fillet_size: Iradiyasi kumele ibe yinombolo engaphezu kwezero.
nurbs.err.fillet_radius: Ibhola elizungezayo leradiyasi {radius} mm alilingani nenhlangothi {name}: lingaphuma enhlangothini, noma inhlangothi igoba ngokuqinile kunalokho. Zama iradiyasi encane. Akukho okushintshiwe.
nurbs.err.fillet_closed_var: Iradiyasi eshintsha ngomphetho idinga umphetho oneziphetho ezimbili; lo mphetho uzungeza yonke indawo.
nurbs.err.fillet_end: I-fillet yangaphakathi ingaphela kuphela enhlangothini eqondile ethe tshe ngokuhambisana nomphetho; inhlangothi {name} ekuphelweni kwayo ayisiyo. Akukho okushintshiwe.
nurbs.err.fillet_hits: I-fillet izophinda ishintshe ezinye izingxenye zesolidi {name} (cishe {mm3} mm³ ngaphezu komphetho ogoqiwe). Zama iradiyasi encane. Akukho okushintshiwe.
nurbs.err.thicken_size: Ukuqina kumele kube yinombolo engaphezu kwezero.
nurbs.err.thicken_fold: Indawo {name} igoba ngokuqinile kunobukhulu {thickness} mm ohlangothini lolo (iradiyasi {radius} mm, eduze: {at}), ngakho ukubuyiselwa kuzogoba. Sebenzisa ukuqina okuncane noma enye inhlangothi. Akukho okushintshiwe.
nurbs.err.thicken_self: Ukujiya {name} ngobukhulu {thickness} mm kungena esinye isingxenye salendawo efanayo (kukhona {gap} mm kuphela, eduze: {at}). Sebenzisa ukuqina okuncane noma enye inhlangothi. Akukho okushintshiwe.
nurbs.err.thicken_open: Izinhlangothi ezijiyiwe zendawo {name} azivalekanga zibe yisolidi. Akukho okushintshiwe.
nurbs.ui.solid.fillet_done: Iradiyasi ye-fillet {r} mm: izingxenye {n}, indawo egoqiwe ingaphakathi kwebanga {dev} mm kwibhola elizungezayo, ihlangana nazo zombili izinhlangothi ngaphakathi kwe-engeli: {angle}°.
nurbs.ui.solid.fillet_var: Iradiyasi ye-fillet {r} kuya {r2} mm: izingxenye {n}, indawo egoqiwe ingaphakathi kwebanga {dev} mm kwibhola elizungezayo, ihlangana nazo zombili izinhlangothi ngaphakathi kwe-engeli: {angle}°.
nurbs.ui.solid.thicken_done: {what}: ubukhulu {t} mm, ivolumu {volume} mm³; indawo ejiyiwe ingaphakathi kwebanga {off} mm ebukhulwini kuzo zonke izindawo ezilinganiswe (ukubekezelela {tol} mm).
nurbs.ui.exported_shells: Izisolidi {n} zibhalwe njengegobolondo elivaliwe ngalinye; {open} zibhalwe njengezinhlangothi ezihlukene (izinhlangothi zazo azihlanganisanga ngomphetho ngomphetho).
nurbs.err.fillet_none: Khetha izinhlangothi ezimbili zomphetho ngamunye ozogoqwa, enye ngemuva kwenye. Akukho okushintshiwe.
nurbs.err.fillet_dup: Umphetho phakathi kwezinhlangothi {a} kanye {b} ukhethwe kabili. Akukho okushintshiwe.
nurbs.err.fillet_corner: Imiphetho emithathu egoqiwe ihlangana ekhoneni lesolidi {name}, futhi iradiyasi {radius} mm ayisivumeli ikhoni lesfere emphethweni omfushane (umphetho kumele ube okungenani kabili iradiyasi lapho zombili iziphetho zawo ziyizinkhona ezinjalo). Zama iradiyasi encane. Akukho okushintshiwe.
nurbs.ui.solid.fillet_corners: ; amakhoni {sphere} agoqwe njengesiqephu sesfere esithintana nazo zonke izi-fillet ezintathu, amakhoni {mitre} lapho izi-fillet ezimbili zingenana ngomugqa wokuhlangana kwazo
nurbs.ui.opt.corners: Amakhoni (isiqephu sesfere lapho kuhlangana into ezintathu)
nurbs.err.cage_nopatch: Isamba samaquads: {n}. Akekho okungenziwa abe nembile: ngalinye lithinta umngcele wekheji noma i-vertex engenawo amaedge amane.
nurbs.ui.cage.none: Khetha imeshi kuqala: amaquads ayo yikheji.
nurbs.ui.cage.done: Kwenziwe izindawo ezinembile: {n}. Amaquads ekheji: {quads}. Ama-patch e-bicubic B-spline, umkhawulo we-Catmull–Clark, hhayi ukulinganisa.
nurbs.ui.cage.boundary: Kushiywe: {n}. Amaquads asemphethelweni wekheji ashiywe ngaphandle; umphetho awunayo i-patch enembile lapha.
nurbs.ui.cage.valence: Kushiywe: {n}. Amaquads athinta i-vertex enamaedge angewona amane: indawo yomkhawulo lapho akuyona isethi ephelile yama-patch.
nurbs.ui.cage.open: Kushiywe: {n}. Amaquads ashiywe ngoba omakhelwane bawo bavaleki (umgodi noma uhlangothi oluguqukile eduze kwawo).
